This midrash calls the questioner Avnimos the weaver and sends him to Abba Yosef the builder to ask about creation.

Ruth Rabbah explicitly says that Meir found them sitting in mourning. “Show him his face” is an over-literal rendering of the visit in this context.
The cited episode names Avnimos the weaver, his mother’s death, and Meir’s visit to the mourners.
